description: Path-level semi-open release package scanner rules. The scanner does not open files that match sensitive path patterns.

allowlist.reason: Semi-open user guide is safe and required.
Runtime wrapper is required for readonly validation.
Policy docs may include token in filename without containing credential values.
Contract docs may include token in filename without containing credential values.
Summary docs may include token in filename without containing credential values.

denylist.reason: Git metadata must not be packaged.
Git metadata must not be packaged.
SSO auth state directory must not be packaged.
Auth state JSON files must not be packaged.
storageState JSON files must not be packaged.
Auth-state documentation should be reviewed before semi-open packaging.
Cookie-bearing files must not be packaged.
Session-bearing files must not be packaged unless explicitly reviewed.
Historical dist packages must not be nested in release packages.
Nested release packages indicate packaging recursion.
Drafts are development artifacts.
Intermediate artifacts are development assets.
Run logs should be selected and redacted, not included wholesale.
Full regression case libraries should not enter semi-open runtime packages.
Full prompt injection cases should not enter semi-open runtime packages.
Full asset extraction cases should not enter semi-open runtime packages.
Prefer smoke test summary for semi-open packages.
Raw skill prompts are core assets.
Prompt source should be summarized unless runtime owner approves.
POC process files are development assets.
Observation files may contain sensitive details and should be selected/redacted.

aggregate_rules.reason: More than 10 run logs suggests full run log inclusion rather than selected readiness summaries.
Multiple regression case files suggests full test library inclusion.
